lines.2: 「Inori overslept and will be late. I flew on ahead by myself.」
lines.3: 「Seriously, why is she late every single day?」
lines.5: 「Let me teach you something useful. If you sharpen pencils with a little knife from childhood, you'll grow up good with your hands.」
lines.6: What era was that bird even from...?
lines.7: Still, as someone who builds ships in bottles for fun, I was glad to know it.
lines.8: Not that there was much I could do about it now.
